detail.longDescription:
A few years ago I believed success meant pushing harder, sleeping less, and living at my limit.

It didn't make me faster. It made me tired, and tired people make bad decisions.

Now I follow a Swedish word: lagom. Not too much, not too little, just enough.

Ambition still matters. But a pace you can keep for ten years beats a sprint that burns you out in one.

#Founders #Burnout #Productivity
